title: ONCF Adds 237 Daily Trains for Summer 2026 — Marrakech-Casablanca Route Gets Priority
body:
ONCF deployed its largest-ever summer schedule with 237 additional daily train services. The Marrakech-Casablanca corridor rises from 28 to 42 daily trains in each direction during peak weeks.

Tips

Book via oncf.ma app at least 3 days ahead for peak dates. Special night trains run after midnight on World Cup match days. Airport shuttle from Marrakech station runs every 20 minutes during summer.

Source: ONCF summer 2026 press release, via Kech24.
